command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
Write-Host "=== STATUS ==="
& git status --porcelain=v1 -uall
Write-Host "=== WORKTREES ==="
& git worktree list --porcelain
$target=Join-Path $repo "965093aa9397b0e0419c94270e636d1d427a8948"
Write-Host "=== TARGET ==="
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $target){
  $item=Get-Item -Force -LiteralPath $target
  Write-Host ("TYPE="+$item.GetType().FullName)
  Write-Host ("CREATED="+$item.CreationTimeUtc.ToString("O"))
  Write-Host ("MODIFIED="+$item.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString("O"))
  Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath $target | Select-Object -First 80 Name,Mode,Length,CreationTimeUtc,LastWriteTimeUtc | Format-Table -AutoSize
  $gitMarker=Join-Path $target ".git"
  if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $gitMarker){
    Write-Host "=== TARGET .git ==="
    Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $gitMarker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  }
}else{
  Write-Host "TARGET_MISSING"
}
